Coloured end panels run to the insert edges. The centre holds only the handwritten name. A translucent case surrounds the printed insert, with reflections on the plastic.

Objects share the shelf

Two trailing plants sit on the wooden shelf, their vines dropping past its edge. The ceramic bird takes a new position on each page load and stays there while you browse. The cat is removed.

Shade lifts when you reach for a tape

Tapes sit in soft shade. Hover or keyboard focus raises a tape 10 px, brightens it, and catches more light on its case. Reduced motion keeps the lighting response without movement.
